name: 妮科尔·麦克林
name_full: 妮科尔·麦克林 Nicole McClean

last_movies.title: The Wife and Her House Husband

introduction: Nicole McClean is an actress and independent film director and producer of English and Chinese-Malaysian heritage, based in London. She holds a 2:1 (HONS) degree in Theatre and Performance Arts and Design Arts from Plymouth University and trained as an actress at The Courtyard-The Court Theatre Training Company (London). Trained as a dancer at Jeannine Greville Dancing Academies and The Royal Ballet School, Nicole is also a skilled gymnast and competed in Gymnastics for Berkshire (Pinewood Gymnastics). She is also a qualified personal trainer and artist.Her extensive acting career spans Theatre, TV, films, and commercials. She set up her own production company in 2023, McClean Productions where she produced her first short film, "A Tidy Robbery" which was long-listed for the Funny Women awards and had its festival premiere at The Fort Lauderdale International Film Festival. Nicole is fluent in French.
